name: Your Business
_comment: This is a neutral blank-canvas starter, not a real brand. It carries no company's identity on purpose, so a new owner's very first creative act (run /brand-my-workspace, or ask to build your brand) fills it in and every BOS studio becomes theirs in one shot. After it is set, run `python tools/sync-brand.py` to refresh logo + favicons in each studio's public/ folder. Studios import this JSON via src/brand.js, no other files need touching.
